liquidate(address,address,address,addres.notice: Owner-only whale liquidation. `account` is the mToken borrower parameter (the LiquidateBorrow event's borrower field, e.g. the smart wallet), `holder` is the probed holder of the borrow (event holder field). Repay is sized from the live shortfall (half the shortfall, capped by maxRepay and, for a USDC borrow, by half the borrow balance; the mToken further caps inside liquidateBorrow; Morpho charges no premium, so a capped-down repayment is free). `borrowSwapData` is the pool calldata for USDC -> borrow underlying (ignored when the borrow underlying IS USDC); `sellSwapData1` sells the redeemed underlying (or its intermediate token) on the first pool; `sellSwapData2` + `sellPool2` (empty/zero = single hop) sell the intermediate token1 output of swap1 on the second pool — the two-hop sale the measured whale winner used (WADO -> WETH -> USDC). Each swap's amount slot (the int256 amountSpecified word, bytes [68:100) of the swap calldata) is overwritten with the exact amount THIS contract measured, so the bot's pre-sized calldata cannot over-spend the operation. Reverts (burning only gas) unless the USDC balance ends >= start + minProfit + 1.

onMorphoFlashLoan(uint256,bytes).notice: Morpho flash-loan callback (selector 0x31f57072). Fires only while an owner-authorized operation is active. Sells ONLY the newly seized collateral delta — never retained inventory — on the whitelisted pools; the pool pays the output side and calls back for the input side.

pancakeV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,byte.notice: PancakeSwap V3 names the same callback pancakeV3SwapCallback.

setPoolAllowed(address,bool).notice: Owner may extend the pool whitelist (a newly measured pool for a newly discovered collateral). Owner-only; nothing else can widen the touchable inventory.

sweep(address,address,uint256).notice: Owner may withdraw accumulated profits. Principal at risk is bounded by liquidate()'s revert condition, not by sweep().

uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,byte.notice: Uniswap V3 / Pancake V3 pool callback for direct pool swaps: the pool transferred the output token to us and is owed the input side. `data` = abi.encode(poolToken0, poolToken1) — the convention verified on the fork against the live pool (morpho-watcher-base executor, tx 0x2d56cc60: the pool calls uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,bytes), selector 0xfa461e33, with data abi.encode(USDC, cbZEC)). We pay the token whose delta is positive, so both pool orientations work (collateral may be token0 or token1). Router-style swaps do not call back and cannot be used with this executor.
